# What a set-point optimum does beyond what couples in

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-a-set-point-optimum-does-beyond` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](what-a-set-point-optimum-does-beyond.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where an eligible outcome reaches its set point, every optimum of a nearing order stands there, the class asking nothing more of what lies beyond; below it the order rises and drains; the draw at it is the shortfall with the loss; holders losing together more than a condition is given end it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. One outcome is nearer a family's set point than another where at each condition of the family it lies between the set point and the other (Regulation.Between: on the other's side, no farther) and at one it is strictly nearer, whatever either holds beyond; an order is nearing where it ranks above every nearer outcome: strictly single-peaked at the set point at each condition, each peak independent. Near-definitional. (`Becoming.Optimum.gapTo`, `Becoming.Optimum.Nearer`, `Becoming.Optimum.Nearing`, `Becoming.Optimum.AtSetPoint`, `Becoming.Optimum.UpToSetPoint`, `Becoming.Optimum.setPoint_between`, `Becoming.Optimum.Nearer.gaps`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. An order falling with the distance from the set point at each condition of the family, both sides alike, is nearing, the order by the family's total gap among them; every order ranking above wherever a nearing order does is nearing. At the set point the gap and the family's total gap are nothing, and a family of one condition is at its set point where that condition is. (`Becoming.Optimum.byGap`, `Becoming.Optimum.nearing_of_gaps`, `Becoming.Optimum.byGap_nearing`, `Becoming.Optimum.Nearing.mono`, `Becoming.Optimum.gapTo_eq_zero`, `Becoming.Optimum.total_gapTo_eq_zero`, `Becoming.Optimum.atSetPoint_single`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Where the family holds a condition, no nearing order that never ranks two outcomes above each other is rising: an outcome at the set point is nearer it than every outcome off it at a condition of the family, so the set point and the outcome one above it everywhere would each rank above the other. (`Becoming.Optimum.nearer_of_atSetPoint`, `Becoming.Optimum.Nearing.not_rising`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Where the family holds a condition, an order under which some outcome is ranked below none is not rising, the outcome one higher everywhere exceeding it on the family. Under the order by distance no outcome ranks above one at the set point, and an eligible outcome at the set point is an optimum; neither it nor the order with the beyond counted after, which never ranks two outcomes above each other, is rising. (`Becoming.Optimum.not_rising_of_unbeaten`, `Becoming.Optimum.byGap_unbeaten_at`, `Becoming.Optimum.atSetPoint_frontier`, `Becoming.Optimum.byGap_not_rising`, `Becoming.Optimum.byGapThen_asymm`, `Becoming.Optimum.byGapThen_not_rising`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Every order nearing a set point has its optima at the set point exactly where no eligible outcome off it at a condition of the family is unbeaten by an eligible outcome nearer it; so where some eligible outcome stands at the set point, every optimum of every nearing order does, whatever the room. (`Becoming.Optimum.atSetPoint_iff`, `Becoming.Optimum.atSetPoint_of_reach`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. Where the levels are, for each of several optimizers, an optimum among the outcomes eligible to it of an order nearing the set point on its family, one of those outcomes standing at the set point, the levels stand at the set point on every family the optimizers' families cover. (`Becoming.Optimum.mutual_atSetPoint`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. Where an eligible outcome stands at the set point, an outcome is an optimum of some nearing order exactly where it is eligible and at the set point (near-definitional), and every optimum of every nearing order stands beyond at the least level among the eligible outcomes at the set point exactly where those all stand alike beyond: the class asks nothing of what lies beyond. (`Becoming.Optimum.optima_iff`, `Becoming.Optimum.least_at_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. The order by distance with the beyond counted after (nearer first, then more beyond in total) is nearing; where an eligible outcome stands at the set point, every optimum of it stands there and leaves the beyond, in total, at least where every eligible outcome at the set point does (near-definitional), and with one condition beyond meets a need there exactly where some such outcome does. (`Becoming.Optimum.byGapThen`, `Becoming.Optimum.byGapThen_nearing`, `Becoming.Optimum.counted_after_most`, `Becoming.Optimum.counted_after_keeps_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. The order by distance with less beyond counted after (nearer first, then less beyond in total) is nearing. (`Becoming.Optimum.byGapLess`, `Becoming.Optimum.byGapLess_nearing`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

Up to the set point the gap at a condition is what it falls short, so one outcome is nearer than another exactly where it exceeds the other on the family, and there a nearing order ranks above every exceeding outcome. Within a bound, one shortfall is at most, or less than, another exactly where its amount is at least, or greater than, the other's. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own. Any outcomes (level functions after a step, amounts natural numbers) and orders; which outcomes are eligible, whether one reaches the set point, and room up to it are supplied wherever they enter.
- For the draw, balance with the whole (the family with the conditions beyond) gaining nothing across the step, and for the breaks each condition beyond depended on at a need it meets; for the exchange, the outcomes open to a part within its capacities, the rest exchanging as it does (Flow.Outcome).
- For several optimizers, one set point on shared conditions, the outcomes eligible to each supplied. For joint excess, activity needing support (Dependent), only active formations giving (Acting), the gate local at need m, and the holders alone exchanging with their families, holding their stocks and losing at least the amounts supplied.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That an agent's preferences form a nearing order: they do where strictly single-peaked at each observed condition, each peak independent; a tolerance band around the set point is not one, nor is a best level depending on other conditions.
- Any probability, surprisal, expected free energy or precision: active inference's preferences, prior beliefs over outcomes, are read as a nearing order at the high-precision limit.
- That a set point protects what lies beyond: in a witness where a step can lose what it takes, the order by distance has the draining step among its optima beside the keeping one; what protects is the choice among equal optima. Witness: `Becoming.Optimum.Topped.nearing_either`.
- The quantilizer bound: a choice drawn from a base distribution over the ways of reaching the set point would inherit it (Taylor 2016); that is a reading, not proved here.
- Anything over a horizon or under noise: every law is of one step or of supplied courses, and deterministic; under noise a set point on later states makes reserves worth holding, so a rising drive on stores can return.
- Which optimum is taken where several stand at the set point; the optima where none reaches it and some stand above, or in an exchange at or above it beyond the witnesses.
- Conflicting set points, or optimizers read off an exchange: several share one set point, their eligible outcomes supplied; terms counted after are lexicographic, a weighted term trading against the set point (Topped.weighted_keeps).
- That the beyond's fall is a harm, or that keeping is better: no evaluation enters; ranking courses needs C or a premise in its place.
- **Counterexample:** The set point alone does not protect: from a store at its set point, the step exchanging nothing and the step taking a unit of the source and losing it are both optima of the order by distance, the first meeting the dweller's need and the second not (Topped.nearing_either). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SetPointOptimum.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Counted after the set point, the beyond is maximized in total, not at each condition: of two ways of reaching the set point, every optimum empties a condition beyond that the even way keeps (Spread.counted_after_empties). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SetPointOptimum.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A nearing order can drive the drain at its set point: with less source counted after, every optimum leaves the source below the dweller's need (Topped.counted_less_drains). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SetPointOptimum.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Each within the slack, together past it: two takers each short of its set point by no more than the slack break the dweller at their joint best response (TwoStores.jointly_broken). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SetPointOptimum.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Active inference (Friston, FitzGerald, Rigoli, Schwartenbeck, O'Doherty and Pezzulo 2016, 'Active inference and learning', Neuroscience & Biobehavioral Reviews 68): preferences are prior beliefs over outcomes, highest at the characteristic states; strictly single-peaked at each observed condition, each peak independent, they form a nearing order. Homeostatic reinforcement learning (Keramati and Gutkin 2014, eLife 3): the drive, a norm of the deviations from set points, falls with the distance alike on both sides, so its order is nearing. Satisficing (Simon 1955, Quarterly Journal of Economics 69): an aspiration level has a plateau, as a set point reached has, and a term counted after either decides within it. Quantilizers (Taylor 2016): what protects at the set point is the choice among equal optima, mild optimization's point; its bound is a reading. Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell (NeurIPS 2020): the rising case, which a nearing order meets below its set point. Neighbours, not containments; cited from bibliographic knowledge, no source fetched; the readings are the AI's, in development/ue1b-set-points/NOTE.md, with the review in REVIEW-UE1b.md.
